coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web pass: nine captured grouped native-web queries with 182 returned result headers, covering general/weekly searches, Portuguese and selected Cape Verdean Creole terms, local/national media, event follow-up, strikes, and island leads. Three source cards have readable body text and six are search-only. This does not reproduce LexisNexis or a systematic press-archive review; indexing, local-language and island coverage are incomplete, and results include query noise. No exhaustive search or event-absence claim is made.
